etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin restrictus, perfect passive participle of restringō (“draw back tightly; restrain, restrict”), from re- (“back, again”) + stringō (“press, tighten, compress”). Doublet of ristretto as an adjective.

definitions.definition: To restrain within boundaries; to limit; to confine

quote.citation: 2011 September 28, Jon Smith, “Valencia 1 - 1 Chelsea”, in BBC Sport‎[1]:
quote.text: It was no less than Valencia deserved after dominating possession in the final 20 minutes although Chelsea defended resolutely and restricted the Spanish side to shooting from long range.

definitions.definition: (specifically, mathematics) To consider (a function) as defined on a subset of its original domain.
